findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "witness" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gaip_citation_witness, gaip_record_extract, gaip_evidence_pack · Private data: witness_register_terms, verify_gaip_receipt, gaip_watch_register, gaip_watch_list, gaip_watch_remove, gaip_record_extract, assurance_prepare, assurance_complete, assurance_verify, gaip_verify_supplier_claims, gaip_evidence_pack, gaip_measure_outcome_value · Public sink: gaip_watch_register, gaip_watch_list, gaip_watch_events · Destructive: gaip_receipt_export, gaip_watch_remove.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gaip_citation_witness, gaip_record_extract, gaip_evidence_pack · Private data: witness_register_terms, verify_gaip_receipt, gaip_watch_register, gaip_watch_list, gaip_watch_remove, gaip_record_extract, assurance_prepare, assurance_complete, assurance_verify, gaip_verify_supplier_claims, gaip_evidence_pack, gaip_measure_outcome_value · Public sink: gaip_watch_register, gaip_watch_list, gaip_watch_events · Destructive: gaip_receipt_export, gaip_watch_remove

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
